title: IHEval: Evaluating Language Models on Following the Instruction Hierarchy
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the technical ability of language models to prioritize different types of instructions (system messages, user messages, etc.) according to a hierarchy. While it includes a 'Safety Defense' category, this is limited to technical security scenarios (like password extraction) and does not involve evaluating religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical systems.
